_comment: Domain-specific business-logic vulnerability hypotheses. The hypothesize step picks the matching domain(s) and seeds these as candidate hypotheses, then the LLM adds service-specific ones. Each producer/consumer treats these as things to VERIFY against the code, not as confirmed findings.

hypotheses.name: negative or zero amount
hypotheses.why: amount fields that accept <=0 can reverse a transfer or mint value
hypotheses.check_how: find transfer/withdraw/charge handlers; check amount is validated > 0 server-side, not just client

hypotheses.name: double-spend / race on balance
hypotheses.why: concurrent withdrawals reading the same balance before either commits
hypotheses.check_how: check balance debit is atomic (row lock / SELECT FOR UPDATE / compare-and-set), not read-then-write

hypotheses.name: limit / balance bypass
hypotheses.why: overdraft or limit enforced on a stale or client-supplied value
hypotheses.check_how: trace where the available balance/limit is read vs where the debit is applied; look for TOCTOU

hypotheses.name: rounding / fx ordering
hypotheses.why: rounding before vs after fx, or truncation, leaks fractional value repeatedly
hypotheses.check_how: inspect order of multiply/convert/round in fee and fx code paths

hypotheses.name: idempotency / replay
hypotheses.why: replaying a transfer request without an idempotency key duplicates it
hypotheses.check_how: check transfer/charge endpoints require and enforce a unique idempotency key

hypotheses.name: cross-account operation
hypotheses.why: acting on another user's account/transaction id (IDOR on money)
hypotheses.check_how: every account/txn lookup must scope to the authenticated owner

hypotheses.name: protected branch bypass
hypotheses.why: push/merge path that skips the protected-branch / approval gate
hypotheses.check_how: trace push and merge handlers; confirm protected-branch and required-approval checks are enforced server-side on every path

hypotheses.name: fork MR secret/variable theft
hypotheses.why: a pipeline triggered from a fork MR running with target-project CI variables/secrets
hypotheses.check_how: check whether fork-originated pipelines get protected CI variables or run in the parent context

hypotheses.name: self-approval of own MR
hypotheses.why: author approving their own merge request defeats review control
hypotheses.check_how: verify approval logic excludes the MR author / commit author

hypotheses.name: token / scope escalation
hypotheses.why: a low-scope token reaching higher-scope actions
hypotheses.check_how: map token scopes to the actions each route allows; look for missing scope checks

hypotheses.name: CI/runner command construction
hypotheses.why: user-influenced strings interpolated into shell/CI scripts run on a runner
hypotheses.check_how: trace user input into pipeline/job script assembly and runner execution

hypotheses.name: webhook / import URL SSRF
hypotheses.why: server fetches a user-supplied URL (webhook test, repo import, mirror)
hypotheses.check_how: find URL-fetching features; check allow-list / internal-range blocking, and DNS-rebinding handling

hypotheses.name: block / mute bypass
hypotheses.why: a blocked user still reaching the blocker via an alternate route (mention, DM, API)
hypotheses.check_how: check every interaction path (DM, mention, follow, api) re-checks the block relationship

hypotheses.name: deleted/private content exposure
hypotheses.why: soft-deleted or private posts still served via cache, API, search, or edit history
hypotheses.check_how: trace read paths (api, search index, cache, revisions) for the visibility/deleted check

hypotheses.name: vote/like manipulation
hypotheses.why: vote not deduplicated per-user or accepts repeated/forged casts
hypotheses.check_how: check vote endpoint enforces one-per-user server-side and authorizes the actor

hypotheses.name: moderation/report bypass
hypotheses.why: acting on or viewing reports without moderator role
hypotheses.check_how: verify moderation routes require a moderator/admin role, not just authentication

hypotheses.name: edit/delete others' content
hypotheses.why: post/comment id acted on without ownership check
hypotheses.check_how: every edit/delete must verify the actor owns the target resource

hypotheses.name: object reference without ownership
hypotheses.why: resource fetched by id with no owner/tenant scope
hypotheses.check_how: every id lookup reachable from a route must scope to the authenticated principal

hypotheses.name: missing authorization on state change
hypotheses.why: create/update/delete reachable without a role/permission check
hypotheses.check_how: trace each mutating route to its authz gate; flag if none

hypotheses.name: role/permission self-grant
hypotheses.why: a user setting their own role/permission fields via mass-assignment
hypotheses.check_how: check role/permission attributes are not settable from user-controlled params

hypotheses.name: state-machine violation
hypotheses.why: reaching a later state without the required prior transition (e.g. pay-skip)
hypotheses.check_how: map the intended state transitions; check each transition enforces its precondition

hypotheses.name: race condition on shared resource
hypotheses.why: check-then-act on a shared counter/quota/balance without locking
hypotheses.check_how: look for read-modify-write on shared state without atomicity
